explanation: F(4) ≤ 15, an improvement over the paper's 19 via a stated explicit 15-vertex graph (the Grötzsch graph plus four vertices, with degrees 2,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,4,5,5,5,6,6,6, so f = 3), with a linked Lean proof. It is a correct, documented strengthening and not claimed by the source. Source: Erdős–Fajtlowicz–Staton, 'Degree sequences in triangle-free graphs', Discrete Math. 92 (1991) 85–88. The full text was not accessible; the zbMATH review summary says that triangle-free graphs in which no degree occurs more than twice are bipartite, and that every triangle-free graph is an induced subgraph of one in which no degree occurs more than three times.
